cards.title: 26th — Chief Justice
cards.text: Special Parliamentary Committee picks the CJP from the 3 senior-most judges; fixed 3-year term

cards.title: 26th — benches and rights
cards.text: Constitutional benches (Art. 191A); Art. 9A clean environment; riba by 1 Jan 2028

cards.title: 27th — Federal Constitutional Court
cards.text: Art. 175C; first CJ Aminuddin Khan; binds the Supreme Court

cards.title: 27th — Chief of Defence Forces
cards.text: Art. 243; COAS as CDF (Field Marshal Asim Munir); CJCSC abolished

cards.title: 27th — National Strategic Command
cards.text: Commander NSC (Gen Aamer Raza); lifelong Field Marshal rank

cards.title: 27th — immunity and transfers
cards.text: Art. 248 lifetime presidential immunity; Art. 200 transfers via JCP

title: The Iran war and Pakistan's mediation

steps.title: June 2025 — Twelve-Day War
steps.text: Israeli and US strikes on Fordow, Natanz, Isfahan; ceasefire 24 June

steps.title: 28 Feb 2026 — war begins
steps.text: US–Israeli strikes; Ali Khamenei killed; Hormuz closed; oil above $100

steps.title: 8 Apr 2026 — ceasefire
steps.text: Brokered by Pakistan; Islamabad Talks 11–12 April (Vance and Ghalibaf)

steps.title: 17 Jun 2026 — Islamabad MoU
steps.text: 14-point interim framework; 60 days to a final deal

steps.title: July 2026 — collapse
steps.text: Ship attacks in Hormuz; US strikes and blockade resume

steps.title: Oct 2026 — talks via Qatar, Pakistan, Egypt
steps.text: Iran's phased plan; no formal ceasefire; Houthi attacks on Saudi Arabia
